subject: Request: Form W-8BEN-E signer delegation + PO workflow for Innovex Labs
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@innovexlabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@innovex.com
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup — W-8BEN-E and signer delegation for Redwood PO

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for walking us through Redwood's onboarding checklist last week. We're ready to move forward but have a quick administrative wrinkle. Our finance team is based in Singapore; tax counsel prepared a W-8BEN-E for Innovex Labs with an authorized-signature delegation to our AP director (Jin Park). I attached the signed W-8BEN-E and the delegation letter.

Could you confirm what evidence Redwood needs to validate delegated signers for foreign entities before the PO can be issued? Specifically:
- Is the signed delegation letter sufficient?
- Do you require notarization or a bank letter from Innovex's bank in SG?
- Any form fields we should re-submit to match Redwood's vendor portal?

We'd like to avoid a multi-day PO hold, so happy to provide anything you need.

Attached: Innovex_W-8BEN-E_signed_v1.pdf (pdf), Innovex_Delegation_of_Signer_signed.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Sara Li
Head of Procurement
Innovex Labs

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sara Li <sara.li@innovexlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — W-8BEN-E and signer delegation for Redwood PO

Sara —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. We reviewed the W-8BEN-E and the delegation letter. Two quick notes from procurement/tax ops so we can move the PO to "Active":

1) Delegation evidence: we accept a signed delegation letter, but for non-US payees we require one of the following as supporting evidence (pick one):
   - Notarized delegation letter (preferred), OR
   - Bank confirmation letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership and authorized signers, OR
   - Recent corporate minutes / board resolution naming the delegate.

2) Identification & name alignment: the name on the W-8BEN-E must match the legal entity name in Redwood's vendor portal exactly. If there are DBA lines, list both and attach EITHER a recent bank statement or incorporation certificate.

3) Portal fields: please set Legal Name to "Innovex Labs Pte. Ltd." and Tax ID field to the foreign TIN you cited on page 3. If you upload the notarized delegation as a second attachment, we can queue for expedited review (24–36 hrs).

I'll route this to priyom on the payment side and cc Laura for tax ops sign-off. If you can indicate which evidence you'll provide, we can avoid a PO hold.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Li <sara.li@innovexlabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — W-8BEN-E and signer delegation for Redwood PO

Thanks Karthik — quick follow-up.

We can provide a notarized delegation but it will take a couple business days to arrange remote notarization with our legal counsel in SG. Bank letter is faster: our bank (AsiaTrust Bank) can issue a confirmation letter within 24 hours, but the letter needs to be emailed directly from the bank to Redwood procurement or uploaded to your vendor portal.

Which option would you prefer for fastest PO activation? If bank letter is fine, I can ask the bank to send the PDF to procurement@redwood.com and cc me.

—Sara

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Innovex W-8BEN-E — recommended conditional path

Karthik — quick internal note (please keep on-thread). I reviewed the W-8BEN-E and the delegation PDF. The delegation looks legitimately signed, but because it's a foreign entity we should ask for the bank letter to close the loop. Operationally:

- If Innovex can have AsiaTrust send a bank confirmation PDF directly to procurement@redwood.com, CS and payments can approve a conditional PO (terms: POs can be issued with payment hold until bank letter arrives; release on receipt).
- If they prefer notarization, expect a 48–72 hour hold.
- Prio: expedite bank letter route to minimize time-to-service.

I'll stand by to override the payment hold if priyom confirms risk tolerance.

—Laura
Director, Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference
